I have 0.24 hectares of maize here, and with the rains coming in November, I need to make sure I get a good harvest for my family. I was able to get my fertilizer coupons through FISP this year, so I will apply both NPK and urea on this plot because without that subsidy I could never afford the bags at market price. I will also use the hybrid maize seed that came with the program, since it gives much better yield than the local variety, even though I know I need to keep some grain aside for seed if the budget is tight next season. I will not spray any chemicals on the maize because pests have not been a big problem before, and I do not have money for pesticides on a food crop; the rain will be enough, so I will not irrigate either. For labor, my wife and children will help with planting and weeding, but during the busy weeding period I may need to hire a few days of help from neighbors so the maize does not get choked by weeds.
